samples.summary: Todo doc cites a stale line number for the shift+click bug location that no longer matches the code at that line
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260914-table-drag-merge-selection-todo.md states: "Shift+clicking a cell in another row creates no cell range at all — the `else` arm at `text-editor.ts:2021` collapses the caret." Reading packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts line 2021 today shows unrelated header/footer click-ignore code ("Single-click on inactive header/footer region: ignore"); the actual shift+click-on-cell logic (including the caret-collapsing else arm this describes) now lives around lines 2082-2118, since the fix described in the same doc has already been applied in the working tree, shifting line numbers. A reader trying to verify the claim at the cited line will find it does not match.
